```yaml
name: ADR Agent

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  adr-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '^(docs/adr/|src/|include/|CMakeLists.txt|Makefile)$'

      - name: Prepare prompt
        id: prompt
        run: |
          echo "## Prompt" > prompt.txt
          echo "The following files were changed in this PR:" >> prompt.txt
          echo "${{ steps.changed.outputs.modified }}" | jq -r '.[]' >> prompt.txt
          echo "" >> prompt.txt
          cat <<EOF >> prompt.txt
          You are an expert DevOps engineer who writes GitHub Actions workflows.  
          Validate whether the changed code aligns with existing ADRs in `docs/adr/`.  
          Identify any architectural decisions introduced or changed by this commit that are not yet documented.  
          Write any missing ADR(s) following the template in `.github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md`.  
          Commit the new ADR file(s) to `docs/adr/` and open a pull request.  
          If no new ADR is required, close this issue with a comment explaining why.  
          Do not modify existing accepted ADRs; create a superseding ADR instead.  
          EOF
          cat prompt.txt

      - name: Run ADR Agent
        id: agent
        uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
        with:
          model: gpt-4o-mini
          agent: .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
          share: false
          prompt: ${{ steps.prompt.outputs.prompt }}
          use_github_token: true
          mentions: ""
          variant: default
          oidc_base_url: ""

      - name: Capture agent output
        id: capture
        run: |
          echo "## ADR Review Result" > result.txt
          echo "${{ steps.agent.outputs.result }}" >> result.txt

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ${{ steps.capture.outputs.result }}
          file-path: result.txt
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-tag: adr-agent
          mode: replace
```
